fusions.name: Shake Loose
fusions.desc: Seizes the target and shakes it, dealing 14 blunt damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Troop Panic
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back. Shakes spores over every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 8 nature damage, with a 20% chance per hit to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grasping Mantle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left with Rot for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mould Cudgel
fusions.desc: Conjures a cudgel of packed fungus that raises your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%. Every strike with it leaves Rot in the wound for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
